name: Wichita
summary: The next stop on the roadmap: testing the portability of the licensing framework and operational guardrails outside the flagship market.
heroNote: Wichita is where H.O.O.D. Hope proves the model travels — replicating the licensing framework beyond its flagship city.

initiatives.title: Licensing Framework Replication Pilot
initiatives.description: Testing the M.O.U., Program License, and Services Agreement structure with a local nonprofit operator in the Wichita market.

initiatives.title: Local Resource Directory Launch
initiatives.description: Building a verified local resource directory — housing authority, HUD-approved counseling, health, and food access partners — ahead of program launch.

resources.title: Wichita Housing Authority
resources.eligibility: Income-eligible Wichita residents; public housing & Housing Choice Voucher waitlists
resources.note: City of Wichita Housing & Community Services — the public housing agency for Wichita.

resources.title: Urban League of Kansas — Housing Counseling
resources.eligibility: Open to Wichita-area residents; HUD-approved housing counseling

resources.title: HealthCore Clinic
resources.eligibility: Open to all; sliding-fee scale available

resources.eligibility: Open to income-eligible households across Kansas
